howItWorks.title: How Does TempMail Plus Work?
howItWorks.subtitle: Receive disposable email addresses instantly with zero registration.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Pick your desired lifetime from 10 minutes to 5 days. Our system connects to Mail.tm to provision a real inbox immediately.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Use your temporary email on forums, websites, trials, and app registrations. OTP codes and emails appear live with auto-refresh.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about disposable email services and Mail.tm.
faq.a1: A temporary (or disposable) email is a short-lived email address that allows you to receive incoming mail and verification codes without revealing your personal or primary email address.
faq.a2: TempMail Plus utilizes the official Mail.tm API to dynamically allocate real email inboxes. When messages are sent to your temporary address, our backend retrieves them securely and displays them in your live inbox.
faq.q3: How long does my email stay active?
faq.a3: You can choose from 11 duration options before creating your address (from 10 minutes up to 5 days). You can also extend the lifetime by clicking 'Extend Lifetime' before it expires.
faq.q4: Can I choose the email lifetime?
faq.a4: Yes! You have full control over the lifetime duration before generation, ranging from 10 minutes, 30 minutes, 1 hour, 2 hours, 6 hours, 12 hours, to 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 days.
faq.q5: Can I receive verification codes and attachments?
faq.a5: Yes. TempMail Plus supports full incoming email formatting including verification codes, OTPs, rich HTML messages, and downloadable attachments.
faq.q6: Can I send emails from this temporary address?
faq.a6: No. To prevent spam, abuse, and phishing, temporary email services like Mail.tm are strictly designed for receiving emails only.
faq.q7: What happens when my email expires?
faq.a7: Once the countdown reaches zero, the mailbox session expires and access is revoked. You can generate a brand-new disposable address with a single click.
faq.q8: Do I need an account or registration?
faq.a8: No registration, password creation, or credit card is ever required. Your session is generated automatically and tied securely to your current browser.
faq.a9: Temporary email shields your real email from spam databases and trackers. However, as it operates over the public Mail.tm network, do not use temporary emails for highly sensitive personal banking or confidential legal documents.

privacy.title: Privacy & Transparency Policy
privacy.disclaimer: TempMail Plus acts as a secure client interface for the Mail.tm API. We do not maintain permanent user databases or sell telemetry data. Temporary mailbox tokens are kept in transient session storage and discarded upon expiration or user deletion.
privacy.mailtmNotice: Email transmission and delivery are handled by Mail.tm. Please respect acceptable use policies and avoid illegal activities.
privacy.termsText: This service is provided free of charge for privacy protection and testing purposes. Do not use this service for illicit or unauthorized activities.
